description: This file contains a PHP class implementing internal compile logic for Smarty template engine, specifically for handling {foreach} {section} tags. It defines methods for parsing and matching tag properties within Smarty templates, and generating compiled PHP code.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Private_ForeachSection
classes.description: Class responsible for compiling Smarty {section} and {foreach} tags, handling property parsing and source matching for template compilation.

methods.name: scanForProperties
methods.description: Scans template source for attribute properties related to the {section} or {foreach} tags, building regex patterns to match relevant properties.

methods.name: buildPropertyPreg
methods.description: Constructs the regular expression pattern used to find specific properties within the template source code.

methods.name: matchProperty
methods.description: Performs regex matching on source string to find used tag properties based on the constructed pattern.

methods.name: matchTemplateSource
methods.description: Matches properties within the current template source code.

methods.name: matchParentTemplateSource
methods.description: Recursively searches parent templates for relevant tag properties.

methods.name: matchBlockSource
methods.description: Intended to match properties in {block} tags (no implementation in provided code).

methods.name: compileSpecialVariable
methods.description: Generates PHP code to access special {$smarty.foreach.xxx} or {$smarty.section.xxx} variables.
